verdict.rationale: Pulumi's CLI is explicitly designed for headless/CI usage (non-interactive commands, preview/up), and the Automation API is a first-party programmatic interface for embedding Pulumi programs into automation/CI pipelines without the CLI, plus documented VCS integrations (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps) for CI workflows. This is a well-documented, core capability with clear first-party docs, though independent hands-on CI-specific corroboration is thin. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of CI pipeline usage specifics and edge-case reliability in headless mode.
